import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Plot the distribution of sleep duration and quality of sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.boxplot(x='Quality of Sleep', y='Sleep Duration', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Quality of Sleep')
plt.xlabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.show()

# Plot the relationship between physical activity level and daily steps
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Relationship between Physical Activity Level and Daily Steps')
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps')
plt.show()

# Plot the distribution of stress levels and BMI categories
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='Stress Level', hue='BMI Category', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Distribution of Stress Levels by BMI Category')
plt.xlabel('Stress Level')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='BMI Category')
plt.show()

# Plot the relationship between heart rate and blood pressure
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Heart Rate', y='Blood Pressure', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Relationship between Heart Rate and Blood Pressure')
plt.xlabel('Heart Rate')
plt.ylabel('Blood Pressure')
plt.show()

# Save the final figure
plt.figure(figsize=(15,10))
sns.pairplot(sleep_health)
plt.title('Sleep Health Dataset Correlation Matrix')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

# Plot the distribution of sleep duration and quality of sleep

sns.boxplot(x='Quality of Sleep', y='Sleep Duration', data=sleep_health)

plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.show()

# Plot the relationship between physical activity level and daily steps
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Relationship between Physical Activity Level and Daily Steps')
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps')
plt.show()

# Plot the distribution of stress levels and BMI categories
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='Stress Level', hue='BMI Category', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Distribution of Stress Levels by BMI Category')
plt.xlabel('Stress Level')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='BMI Category')
plt.show()

# Plot the relationship between heart rate and blood pressure
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
